description: Revert to the aggressive learning rate configuration (Matrix LR 0.11, Embedding LR 1.4) and Depth 10, which historically yields ~0.983 bpb, but introduce a more robust warmup schedule (WARMUP_RATIO=0.05) to stabilize the early training phase of the high-LR run, potentially preventing the oscillations that caused previous failures while aiming for faster convergence than the conservative 0.08 LR baseline.
